  opacity: 0.45;
  pointer-events: none; /* 锁死点击事件 */
}

  color: inherit !important;

  box-shadow: none !important;
}

  color-scheme: dark;
  --accent-cherry: #ff1d68;
  --accent-purple: #b134d4;
  --bg-obsidian: linear-gradient(135deg, #1b0c16 0%, #0c0209 100%);

}
.box-shell * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

  position: relative !important;

  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 16px;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 30%, rgba(27, 12, 22, 0.85), transparent 60%),
              radial-gradient(circle at 90% 20%, rgba(122, 12, 50, 0.95), transparent 60%),
              radial-gradient(circle at 50% 80%, rgba(17, 3, 12, 0.8), transparent 70%),
              #0c0209 !important;
  background-size: 200% 200%;
  animation: causalMeshPan 25s ease-in-out infinite;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  border: var(--border) !important;
  border-radius: 28px;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.85), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.05), 0 0 15px rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.15);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.causality-petals {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 999;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.causality-petal {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -30px;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: causalFloatUp 8s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}
@keyframes causalMeshPan {
  0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
  50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
  100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
}

  0% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; }
  15% { opacity: 0.85; }
  85% { opacity: 0.85; }
  100% { transform: translate3d(0, -600px, 0) rotate(360deg); opacity: 0; }

.scanner-circle:active {
  transform: scale(0.92);

/* ⚠️ 动态彩蛋气泡样式 - 360度散射快闪版 */

    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {

  }

.cr-click-bubble {

.tabs-pills {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;

  justify-content: flex-start;

  display: none;

  .tabs-pills {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 99px;

  color: var(--text-muted);

@keyframes tabBounce {

}

.panels-container {

  z-index: 2;

.panels-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--accent-cherry);
  border-radius: 99px;
}

  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.profile-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  align-items: center;
  overflow: visible;
}
.scanner-ring-outer {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: visible;
}
.scanner-ring-outer::before,
.scanner-ring-outer::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border: 2px solid var(--accent-cherry);
  border-radius: 50%;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: scanRipple 3s cubic-bezier(0.12, 0.8, 0.32, 1) infinite;
}
.scanner-ring-outer::after {
  animation-delay: 1.5s;
  border-color: var(--accent-purple);
}
.scanner-badge-core {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 4px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.3);
  background: radial-gradient(circle, #2a0b1c, #0c0209);
  display: grid; 
  place-items: center;
  font-size: 24px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.15);
  animation: scanPulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes scanRipple {
  0% { transform: scale(0.85); opacity: 0.8; box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--accent-cherry); }
  100% { transform: scale(1.4); opacity: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 16px transparent; }
}
@keyframes scanPulse {
  0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 6px rgba(255,29,104,0.1), 0 0 4px rgba(255,29,104,0.15); }
  100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 14px rgba(255,29,104,0.35), 0 0 12px rgba(255,29,104,0.45); border-color: rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.7); }
}
.profile-meta b {
  font-size: 18px; 
  color: #fff;
  text-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
}
.profile-meta span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.bar-group {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.bar-item {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 80px 1fr 100px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin: 10px 0;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.bar-item b {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.bar-outer {
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: #170712;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.bar-inner {
  width: 0%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.bar-inner::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: -150%;
  width: 150%; height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), transparent);
  animation: barShimmer 3s infinite linear;
}
@keyframes barShimmer {
  0% { left: -150%; }
  50% { left: 100%; }
  100% { left: 100%; }
}
@keyframes barOverflow {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 69, 58, 0.4); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255, 69, 58, 0.8), 0 0 4px rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.6); }
}

.inner-cherry {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cherry), #ff8dad);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.4);
}
.inner-violet {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-purple), #e57eff);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(177, 52, 212, 0.4);
}
.bar-item span {
  text-align: right;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-family: monospace;
}

.grid-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.info-card {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 14px;
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1), border-color 0.3s;
}
.info-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.3);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.15);
}
.info-card h4 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--accent-cherry);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.info-card p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.accordion-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.accordion-item {
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  background: var(--card-bg);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.accordion-header {
  padding: 12px 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  transition: background 0.3s;
  user-select: none;
  position: relative;
  gap: 8px;
}
.accordion-header:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.08);
}
.accordion-header::-webkit-details-marker {
  display: none;
}
.accordion-header::after {
  content: '▼';

  color: var(--text-muted);
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
}
.accordion-item[open] .accordion-header::after {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  color: var(--accent-cherry);
}
.accordion-item[open] .accordion-header {
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  background: rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.05);
}
.box-shell .gud-hidden {
  display: none !important;
}
.accordion-body {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
  background: rgba(10, 2, 8, 0.35);
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  padding: 0 18px;
  transition: max-height 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.6s ease-in-out, padding 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
.accordion-item.active .accordion-body {
  max-height: 500px;
  opacity: 1;
  padding: 16px 18px;
}
.accordion-body p {
  margin: 6px 0;
}
.accordion-body b {
  color: #fff;
}
.status-dot {
  width: 8px; 
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 8px;
}
@keyframes pulseGlow {
  0% { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--accent-cherry); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.22); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-cherry), 0 0 4px var(--accent-purple); }
  100% { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--accent-cherry); }
}
.dot-active {
  background: var(--accent-cherry);
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-cherry);
  animation: pulseGlow 2s infinite ease-in-out;
}
.dot-idle {
  background: #444;
}

.contract-card {
  background: rgba(17, 3, 12, 0.80);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  transition: all 0.3s;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.contract-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center; 
  gap: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.contract-status {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.c-locked {
  opacity: 0.55;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  background: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.2);
}
.c-locked .contract-name {
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
.c-locked .contract-status {
  color: #6a535b;
}
.c-active {
  border-color: rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.35);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.08);
}
.c-active .contract-name {
  color: #fff;
  text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.2);
}
.c-active .contract-status {
  color: #ff8dad;
}
.c-active .contract-icon {
  animation: contractPulse 2s infinite ease-in-out;
}
@keyframes contractPulse {
  0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.75; }
  50% { transform: scale(1.15); opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px var(--accent-cherry)); }
  100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.75; }
}
.c-completed {
  border-color: rgba(177, 52, 212, 0.45);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 9, 21, 0.6) 0%, rgba(177, 52, 212, 0.06) 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(177, 52, 212, 0.1);
}
.c-completed .contract-name {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fff, #c582ff);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}
.c-completed .contract-status {
  color: #e57eff;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.c-completed .contract-icon {
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--accent-purple));
}

.contract-card {
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
}
.contract-card.c-locked {
  cursor: not-allowed !important;
}
.contract-body {
  display: block !important;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: max-height 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0.6s ease-in-out, padding 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

  color: #ffccd8 !important; /* 强制使用明亮的粉白色字体，防止隐形 */

.contract-body b, 
.contract-body span {

  border-color: rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.5) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 29, 104, 0.15) !important;

  border-color: rgba(177, 52, 212, 0.65) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(177, 52, 212, 0.3) !important;

.contract-card.active .contract-body {
  max-height: 250px !important; /* 展开后的最大高度 */

  padding-top: 10px !important;

.contract-body p {
  margin: 6px 0 !important;
  color: #ffccd8 !important;
}
.contract-body b {
  color: #ffffff !important; /* 标题文字强制使用纯白色 */

  padding: 12px 16px !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;

document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  //* ⚠️ 360度散射 +0 CR 彩蛋逻辑
  var ptsBadge = e.target.closest('.pts-badge');
  var scannerCircle = e.target.closest('.scanner-circle');
  if (ptsBadge || scannerCircle) {
    var bubble = document.createElement('div');
    bubble.className = 'cr-click-bubble';
    bubble.innerText = '+0 CR';
    
    //* 1. 随机生成 360 度的散射弧度
    var angle = Math.random() * 6.2831853;
    //* 2. 随机生成散射出的距离 (35px 到 75px 之间)
    var distance = 35 + Math.random() * 40;
    
    //* 3. 计算出对应的 X 和 Y 轴偏移量
    var dx = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
    var dy = Math.sin(angle) * distance;
    
    //* 4. 将偏移量作为 CSS 变量绑定到元素上
    bubble.style.setProperty('--dx', dx + 'px');
    bubble.style.setProperty('--dy', dy + 'px');
    
    //* 5. 定位到鼠标点击的绝对坐标
    bubble.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
    bubble.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
    
    document.body.appendChild(bubble);
    
    //* 动画结束（0.4秒后）立即销毁元素
    bubble.addEventListener('animationend', function() {
      bubble.remove();
    });
  }
  var flipTarget = e.target.closest('.gud-flip-card');
  if (flipTarget) {
    flipTarget.classList.toggle('flipped');
    return;
  }
  //* 契约卡片点击展开/折叠逻辑

                        document.getElementById('send_textarea') ||

      if (targetInput) {

        var toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; bottom:120px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); background:rgba(255,29,104,0.95); border:1px solid #ff453a; color:#fff; padding:12px 24px; font-size:12px; border-radius:10px; z-index:99999; box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(255,29,104,0.6); text-align:center; transition:opacity 0.3s;';
